test_title: RRB NTPC - Graduate 2025 (CBT 2) Mid-Range Full Test - 03
subject: general
question: How many unique digital health identities have been created under the Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission to strengthen India’s national digital health ecosystem, as stated by the Union Health Minister at the 79th World Health Assembly?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Over 880 million**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Health Minister **Shri Jagat Prakash Nadda** addressed the plenary session of the **79th World Health Assembly (WHA)** in **Geneva, Switzerland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM):** The Minister informed the assembly that the mission is strengthening the national digital health ecosystem by creating **over 880 million unique digital health identities**.
 
• These identities facilitate **longitudinal health records** and a seamless continuum of care for the citizens.
 
• **Other Figures Mentioned:** While **600 million** refers to the number of beneficiaries covered under the **Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PMJAY)**, the **880 million** figure is specific to digital health IDs.
 
• The Minister also highlighted the establishment of over **1,85,000 Ayushman Arogya Mandirs** to provide primary healthcare services.
 
• The mention of **300 million** in the news refers to the number of **vaccine doses** supplied to other countries under the **Vaccine Maitri** initiative, not digital health identities.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The theme of the 79th WHA address was **“Reshaping Global Health: A Shared Responsibility.”**
 
• India has recently launched the **Strategy for Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare** to build ethical and human-centric systems.
 
• Under the **Vaccine Maitri** initiative, India supplied vaccines to around **100 countries**.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] Important Points__**

 
• India is referred to as the **“Pharmacy of the World”** due to its leadership in producing **affordable generic medicines** and vaccines.
 
• The government is following a **“whole-of-government”** and **“whole-of-society”** approach to achieve **Universal Health Coverage (UHC)**.
